recent_news.headline: Darling Ingredients Q2 2026 call set for July 30
recent_news.summary: Darling Ingredients announced Q2 2026 earnings call scheduled for July 30, 2026. The company processes about 15% of the world's animal agricultural by-products and produces 30% of the world's collagen, while serving as one of the largest renewable energy producers.

recent_news.headline: Darling Ingredients refines its renewable fuels story as investors weigh long term demand
recent_news.summary: Darling Ingredients leverages its waste-to-value model and renewable diesel partnerships to support growth, with investors evaluating demand for low-carbon fuels and sustainable ingredients. The company operates a global platform converting animal by-products, used cooking oil, and residual streams into specialty ingredients and renewable fuels.

recent_news.headline: Darling Ingredients explores strategic paths as sustainable feedstock demand evolves
recent_news.summary: Darling Ingredients faces evolving landscape in renewable fuels and specialty ingredients, prompting review of portfolio, capital allocation and long-term growth strategy. The company supplies animal-derived and other feedstocks supporting renewable fuels, food, feed and pharmaceutical markets.
